name: account
purpose: Single account row — identicon, label and optional balance — the building block of account choosers and confirmation screens, in row or column layout with image, cashlink and editable-label variants.

props.name: label
props.description: The account's display label. Labels shaped like a valid Nimiq address render in Fira Mono uppercase (address-font).

props.name: address
props.description: User-friendly Nimiq address; a checksum-valid address renders its identicon (no identicon otherwise).

props.name: image
props.description: Image URL shown instead of the identicon (1rem radius); falls back to identicon/cashlink rendering on load error.

props.name: displayAsCashlink
props.description: Render the cashlink glyph (white link icon on a navy gradient circle with a 20% navy ring) instead of an identicon.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder for the editable label input.

props.name: walletLabel
props.description: Secondary nq-label line under the label; column layout only.

props.name: balance
props.description: Balance in luna, rendered through Amount when set (0 included); omitted balances render no Amount.

props.name: decimals
props.description: Exact decimals for the balance Amount.

props.name: editable
props.description: Render the label as a LabelInput field (maxBytes 63); emits 'changed' with the new label.

props.name: layout
props.description: 'row' (5.625rem identicon left, balance right, full width) or 'column' (stacked, 10rem identicon, centered label).

notes: Sample state: layout 'row' at 420px (SmallPage width), label 'Main Account', address NQ11 MAIN ACCO UNT0 0000 0000 0000 0000 001X (synthetic but checksum-valid, IBAN mod-97), balance 1234567890 luna. Balance renders '12 345.68 NIM' (U+202F narrow no-break space grouping) because Account defaults decimals to 2 and passes it to Amount as EXACT decimals — unlike AccountList rows, which leave decimals unset and show min 2 / max 5. Identicon via @nimiq/iqons@1.6.0 pinned on jsdelivr with Iqons.svgPath pointed at the vendored iqons.min.svg (same recipe as the identicon component; sprite is the REAL team-shipped 84-symbol catalog at assets/img/iqons.min.svg, CDN fallback byte-identical). Static row state: label and balance at opacity 0.7, label fade-out mask on the right edge. Identicon.vue and Amount.vue scoped styles are inlined in truth/css (their markup is part of the row); the Vue port imports them plus LabelInput from the registry instead. Image/cashlink/column/editable/walletLabel variants carry full styles but are not in the pixel sample; the cashlink glyph svg is upstream's inline icon, kept verbatim in the Vue port. ValidationUtils.isValidAddress from @nimiq/utils@0.11.1 is inlined. Emits 'changed' (editable only); exposes focus().
